One verb, **عرف (3eref)**, does a lot of work. This lesson keeps the grammar light and instead widens the vocabulary you can plug into it. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

**One verb for *saber* and *conhecer*.** Portuguese splits "sei a resposta" from "conheço o Ahmed", but Arabic doesn't: عرف covers knowing a fact, knowing a person, and knowing a place. One verb, three jobs.

**It also loves the participle** — exactly like فاهم from the last lesson. The state "I know" is normally **أنا عارف (ana 3aref)**, not the full present. The past verb *3eref* leans toward "found out / came to know"; the participle *3aref* is "I know it now". Its negative **مش عارف (mesh 3aref)** = "I don't know" (you'll also hear the verb form **معرفش, ma3rafsh**).

**عرف + a verb = "to know how to / to be able to".** Follow عرف with a bare present verb (no بـ): **بعرف أسوق (ba3raf asoo2)** = "I know how to drive / I can drive". This is how Egyptian says "can" without a separate verb.

> To *meet* someone for the first time, use اتعرف على — *et3arrafna* = "we got to know each other / we met".

## To know — عرف — 3eref

**Root:** ع-ر-ف (3-r-f) — regular verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana ha3raf, huwwa hayi3raf*).

| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| أنا بعرف - ana ba3raf | أنا عرفت - ana 3reft |
| إنت بتعرف - inta biti3raf | إنت عرفت - inta 3reft |
| إنتِ بتعرفي - inti biti3rafi | إنتِ عرفتي - inti 3refti |
| هو بيعرف - huwwa biyi3raf | هو عرف - huwwa 3eref |
| هي بتعرف - hiyya biti3raf | هي عرفت - hiyya 3erfet |
| إحنا بنعرف - e7na bini3raf | إحنا عرفنا - e7na 3refna |
| إنتو بتعرفوا - intu biti3rafu | إنتو عرفتوا - intu 3reftu |
| هم بيعرفوا - humma biyi3rafu | هم عرفوا - humma 3erfu |

**Participle of عرف:** عارف / عارفة / عارفين — 3aref / 3arfa / 3arfeen — "knowing / I know" (m. / f. / pl.)

## Expanded vocabulary

The point of this lesson: feed عرف a bigger world. Try each table with *ana 3aref…* or *biti3raf…?*

### People

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| المدير - el-mudeer | the manager / boss |
| الجار - el-gar | the neighbor |
| الدكتور - el-doktor | the doctor |
| حد - 7add | someone / anyone |
| ناس - nas | people |

### Places

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| المكان - el-makan | the place |
| الطريق - el-taree2 | the road / way |
| المطعم - el-mat3am | the restaurant |
| المدينة - el-madina | the city |
| المنطقة - el-manti2a | the area / district |

### Facts and things

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| الجواب - el-gawab | the answer |
| الحقيقة - el-7a2ee2a | the truth |
| الخبر - el-5abar | the news |
| الإسم - el-esm | the name |
| الرقم - el-ra2am | the number |

### Skills (use after عرف + verb)

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| يسوق - yesoo2 | to drive |
| يعوم - ye3oom | to swim |
| يطبخ - yotbo5 | to cook |
| يلعب - yel3ab | to play |
| يكتب - yekteb | to write |

## Dialogue: "Do you know him?"

Tarek asks Salma about the new manager.

<span class="rotulo">طارق — Tarek</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتعرفي المدير الجديد؟</summary>
<span class="fr">biti3rafi el-mudeer el-gedeed?</span>
<span class="en">Do you know the new manager?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">سلمى — Salma</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، عارفاه. هو جاري</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, 3arfaah. huwwa gari</span>
<span class="en">Yes, I know him. He's my neighbor</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">طارق — Tarek</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بيتكلم عربي؟</summary>
<span class="fr">biyitkallim 3araby?</span>
<span class="en">Does he speak Arabic?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">سلمى — Salma</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>أيوة، وبيعرف يتكلم إنجليزي كمان</summary>
<span class="fr">aywa, we biyi3raf yitkallim engelizi kaman</span>
<span class="en">Yes, and he can speak English too</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">طارق — Tarek</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتعرفي مطعم كويس قريب؟</summary>
<span class="fr">biti3rafi mat3am kwayyes 2orayyeb?</span>
<span class="en">Do you know a good restaurant nearby?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">سلمى — Salma</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، معرفش المنطقة كويس</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, ma3rafsh el-manti2a kwayyes</span>
<span class="en">No, I don't know the area well</span>
</details>
